statement: By step 100, RL-Zero-Math has mainly taught the base to open in the RL model's own deliberation mode (the ' line!\n\nOkay' opening that the cue forces in the base), not a sharper, lower-entropy policy; at T 0.6 / top-p 0.95 this long-deliberation mode loops exactly as the cued base does (119 cap hits vs 65 plain), so cap hits jump to roughly the cued-base level at step 100 and stay flat through step 400, until later commit-and-stop training (truncation negatives) removes them.
why_strongest: It accounts for every measured value without positing entropy collapse. (1) Step 100 minus base = +0.076 (about 103 cap hits vs 65). The theory expected a small step-100 rise (0.03) because step 100 is at the weight noise floor (knowledge-9c5052, knowledge-87618d), and the measurement fell outside its interval. Under the rival, a tiny weight change is enough because the opening tokens carry 8-12 nats of KL (result-fdc8da). The level sits just under the cued base's 119 (result-e870a1). (2) Step 400 (+0.066) is no higher than step 100. That fits a one-time mode switch, not a sharpening that keeps building. (3) On the hard set the rise is similar (+0.070), matching how much the cue raises base cap hits there at T 0.6 (result-e5c99c: 173 cued cap hits on hard328). (4) The step-400 loop share (0.80) matches the cued base's share of rule-A / low-ratio loops among its cap hits (92 of 119 = 0.77, knowledge-787e53). (5) It also fits result-44b4df and knowledge-1497e8: the cued base loops at T 0.6 because it cannot sustain its own long deliberation. Restarts and better prefixes fix this, and lower entropy is not needed.

tests.experiment: Share of RL step-100 plain MATH-500 answers (T 0.6 / top-p 0.95) that open in the 'Okay' deliberation format.
tests.recipe: File: s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r3/s0400_s0100-01/out/s0100/P_math500.jsonl. Keep rows with sample == 0. If a problem_index appears more than once, keep the first row in file order. For each kept row take the text field (empty or missing text counts as not matching). The row matches if the substring 'Okay' (case-sensitive) occurs within the first 30 characters of text. Statistic: matching rows / kept rows. Cap-hit rows are included like any other row.
tests.theory_should_say: The theory has step 100 barely changed and only concentrating on the base's existing paths, so it implies a share near the plain base's own rate of about 0.34 (168 of 500 open '.\n\nOkay'), maybe a little higher. The rival says early RL installs the RL opening on most problems.

tests.experiment: Paired cap-hit rate difference at RL step 400, cued prompt minus plain prompt, MATH-500 at T 0.6 / top-p 0.95.
tests.recipe: Files: s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r3/s0400_s0100-01/out/s0400/F_math500.jsonl (A, cue) and s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r3/s0400_s0100-01/out/s0400/P_math500.jsonl (B, plain). In each file keep only rows with sample == 0; if a problem_index appears more than once, keep the first row in file order. Keep problem_index values present in both A and B (set S; problems missing from either are dropped). A row is a cap hit if cap_hit is true, or if cap_hit is missing and finish_reason == 'length'. Statistic: (cap hits in A over S) / |S| minus (cap hits in B over S) / |S|.
tests.theory_should_say: The theory reads the cue's effect on the base (cap hits 65 -> 119, about +0.11) as added effective sharpness, which should stack on a policy that is already sharper, so it implies a clearly positive difference, around +0.05 to +0.11. The rival says step 400 already writes the cue's mode by itself, so the cue adds about nothing.

tests.experiment: Ratio of median generated length of finished answers, RL step 100 over base, plain MATH-500 at T 0.6 / top-p 0.95.
tests.recipe: Files: s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r3/s0400_s0100-01/out/s0100/P_math500.jsonl (A) and s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r3/base-01/out/P_math500.jsonl (B). In each file keep rows with sample == 0; if a problem_index appears more than once, keep the first row in file order. Keep problem_index values present in both files (set S). In each file, finished rows = rows in S with cap_hit false (if cap_hit is missing, finished only if finish_reason == 'stop'); each file's finished set is taken separately (unpaired). Length = the n_new field (rows with n_new missing are dropped). Statistic: median length of A's finished rows divided by median length of B's finished rows (median of an even count = mean of the two middle values).
tests.theory_should_say: The theory's early phase concentrates the policy on the base's own high-probability, accuracy-raising paths. Its finished answers then stay base-like in length, a ratio near 1.0-1.3. The rival's switch to RL-style deliberation roughly doubles the median finished length (base median about 609 tokens, cue-mode answers much longer).
